decisions.reason: As a simple accessory, it only partly builds on the firm's trailer coupling knowledge, limiting its absorptive capacity to learn from early results and improve.
Box car trailers are core to the firm's existing trailer manufacturing knowledge, enabling strong absorptive capacity and learning.
Car transporter trailers extend the firm's semi-trailer capabilities closely, so it can interpret results and improve them.
Low-bed trailers build directly on the firm's heavy trailer expertise, giving high absorptive capacity and clear improvement paths.
High trailer covers are related to trailer bodies but require some cover-specific knowledge; the firm can still learn and may keep them.
This duplicate box car series adds no new knowledge beyond Product B and risks cannibalization, so the firm is likely to drop it.
